title: A transposon-derived transcription factor senses ionic stress through phase separation to govern plant autophagy.
authors: Shao, Yang; Wang, Songyang; Liang, Li; Gong, Biao; Johary, Aurore; Shi, Benhui; Zhang, Linyang; Xu, Yanqun; Joly-Lopez, Zoe; Luo, Zisheng; Bureau, Thomas E; Sun, Jiaqi
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文研究转座子来源的转录因子MUG4通过相分离感知离子胁迫并激活植物自噬基因，虽涉及TF-DNA转录调控和粗粒化MD模拟，但核心是离子感知与相分离，而非TF-DNA结合位点预测或互作机制建模，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Salt stress severely impairs plant growth through two distinct cellular insults: osmotic stress caused by water limitation and ionic toxicity resulting from excessive Na(+) accumulation. Although plant osmosensors have been identified, the mechanisms underlying ionic stress perception remain elusive. Salt stress also activates autophagy, a conserved degradation pathway that removes damaged organelles and protein aggregates to promote stress tolerance. In animals, master regulators such as transcription factor EB (TFEB) coordinate this response by activating autophagy genes across the pathway, but no analogous regulator has been identified in plants. Here, we show that MUSTANG4 (MUG4), a transcription factor derived from Mutator-like element (MULE) transposons, functions as an ionic stress sensor and the primary transcriptional driver of salt-induced autophagy in Arabidopsis. MUG4 responds to elevated monovalent cation concentrations, but not chloride anions or osmotic stress, thereby distinguishing ionic from osmotic stress. Ionic stress compacts the intrinsically disordered region (IDR) of MUG4 and drives liquid-liquid phase separation of the full-length protein, as demonstrated by Forster resonance energy transfer-fluorescence lifetime imaging, in vitro assays, and coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations. Genome-wide in vivo CUT&Tag sequencing and RNA sequencing reveal that MUG4 directly and coordinately activates autophagy genes spanning multiple functional stages of the pathway. IDR deletion abolishes phase separation, reduces autophagy gene activation and autophagic flux, and prevents the truncated protein from rescuing the salt-sensitive phenotype of mug4 mutants. These findings identify a dedicated plant ionic stress sensor and establish a mechanistic link between exapted transposable elements, phase separation, and transcriptional stress responses, thereby integrating ionic stress perception with autophagy activation.
abstract_zh: 盐胁迫通过两种不同的细胞损伤严重抑制植物生长：由水分限制引起的渗透胁迫和由过量Na(+)积累导致的离子毒性。尽管植物渗透传感器已被鉴定，但离子胁迫感知的潜在机制仍不清楚。盐胁迫还激活自噬，这是一种保守的降解途径，可清除受损细胞器和蛋白质聚集体以促进胁迫耐受性。在动物中，主调控因子如转录因子EB (TFEB)通过激活整个途径中的自噬基因来协调这一反应，但植物中尚未鉴定出类似的调控因子。在此，我们表明MUSTANG4 (MUG4)，一种源自Mutator样元件 (MULE) 转座子的转录因子，在拟南芥中作为离子胁迫传感器和盐诱导自噬的主要转录驱动因子发挥作用。MUG4响应升高的单价阳离子浓度，但不响应氯阴离子或渗透胁迫，从而区分离子胁迫与渗透胁迫。离子胁迫压缩MUG4的内在无序区域 (IDR) 并驱动全长蛋白的液-液相分离，这一点通过福斯特共振能量转移-荧光寿命成像、体外实验和粗粒化分子动力学模拟得到证实。全基因组体内CUT&Tag测序和RNA测序揭示，MUG4直接并协调性地激活跨越该途径多个功能阶段的自噬基因。IDR缺失消除相分离，减少自噬基因激活和自噬通量，并阻止截短蛋白拯救mug4突变体的盐敏感表型。这些发现鉴定了一种专门的植物离子胁迫传感器，并建立了外适应转座元件、相分离和转录胁迫反应之间的机制联系，从而将离子胁迫感知与自噬激活整合起来。
